claims.text: The paper proposes speculating tool calls and keeping sequences resident in the inference engine to reduce tool-mediated agent inference overhead.
The authors report throughput improvements of several hundred tokens per second in their evaluated agent-hosting settings.

limitations.text: The throughput result is setup-dependent and author-reported; it should support, not define, the retrospective thesis.
